# Zemberek-NLP Turkish dictionaries

The two dictionaries `tools/gen_turkish_marks.py` reads into
`src/generated/turkish_marks.h`, exactly as published in
`morphology/src/main/resources/tr/` of
`https://github.com/ahmetaa/zemberek-nlp` at commit
`037202c7e18b977c95181a76db05cb1e95846554`. They are covered by the
Apache License 2.0, `LICENSES/Apache-2.0-zemberek.txt`.

SHA-256 of each file:

5704f4017854c474442cce246443b9fec5967799a968ab9d7eb0cce930e32178  proper.dict
